import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # strip whitespace from text columns
    for col in df.select_dtypes(include=['object']).columns:
        df[col] = df[col].apply(lambda x: x.strip() if isinstance(x, str) else x)
    # fix category label variants
    cat_map = {
        'Office Suplies': 'Office Supplies',
        'Furnture': 'Furniture'
    }
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].replace(cat_map)
    # keep only allowed categories
    allowed_cats = ['Electronics', 'Accessories', 'Furniture', 'Office Supplies']
    df = df[df['Category'].isin(allowed_cats)]
    # remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # filter invalid quantity / price
    df = df[(df['Quantity'] >= 1) & (df['Price'] >= 0)]
    # ensure revenue consistency
    df['Revenue'] = df['Quantity'] * df['Price']
    return df

def answer(df):
    # average unit price = mean of Price per Category
    out = df.groupby('Category', dropna=False)['Price'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in out.items()}
